 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. PSG host Lyon today in a massive Ligue 1 clash at the Parc des Princes as both teams enter the match level on 14 points. This match marks a crucial point for both sides as the winner will move on to take the top spot today which is currently held by Rennes with 16 points.
 Ahead of this match, Luis Enrique's side is enjoying an impressive seven-match winning streak across all competitions having beaten Barcelona and Manchester City in the Champions League .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement On the other hand, Paulo Fonseca's Lyon boasts the league's best defense, conceding 0.71 goals per game this season. They have only conceded five goals so far in seven games and wil be a tough opponent for the defending champions today.
 PSG is also dealing with multiple absences for today's match with star forward Ousmane Dembele set to miss this important fixture.
 Why is Ousmane Dembele Not Playing Against Lyon?
 Luis Enrique has major injury concerns on his hands after suffering a huge injury blow during their Champions League triumph over Barcelona. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The French giants lost multiple players with Ousmane Dembele being one of them.
 Leonardo Balerdi is chased by Ousmane Dembélé during the Ligue 1 McDonald's match between Paris Saint-Germain FC and Olympique de Marseille on February 8, 2026.Photo by Antonio Borga/Eurasia Sport Images/Getty Images
 The other injuries include Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, who is out for the season with a torn ACL, while Marquinhos is out for weeks due to a thigh injury along with Nuno Mendes who misses out due to a muscle issue.
 Dembele too is missing today's fixture due to a thigh injury he sustained just 20 minutes into PSG's 4-2 win over Barcelona. The club's medical update confirmed that he is undergoing treatment and is expected to be sidelined for approximately three to four weeks.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Frenchman has already scored 4 goals and made 6 assists across 10 total appearances in all competitions this year and will be heavily missed for the upcoming PSG matches.
